reason: The existing mapping does not provide a defensible and sufficiently complete regulatory basis for the control objective of configurable retention and deletion for prompts, files, outputs, vectors, and logs. While Article 26(6) addresses log retention, it does not cover configurable deletion or the retention of other data types like prompts, files, outputs, and vectors. Article 10(5)(e) addresses deletion of special categories of personal data, but this is limited to bias correction and does not cover the broader scope of the control objective. The mapping lacks a provision that comprehensively supports the configurable retention and deletion of all specified data types.

missing_mappings.reason: This provision mandates log retention for at least six months but does not address configurable deletion or the retention of other data types like prompts, files, outputs, and vectors.

This provision addresses the deletion of special categories of personal data used for bias correction but is limited in scope and does not cover the configurable retention and deletion of all specified data types.

applicability_note: The control is applicable to all systems, requiring configurable retention and deletion for a wide range of data types. The existing mapping fails to cover this broad requirement comprehensively.
challenge_comment: The challenge lies in the lack of a single provision or a combination of provisions that explicitly support the configurable retention and deletion of all specified data types (prompts, files, outputs, vectors, and logs). The existing mapping only partially addresses log retention and a very specific type of data deletion.
